product.name: Red Hook Barcelona Wooden Bench with Faux-Leather Upholstered Cushion - Bittersweet Brown
product.description: 2-person bench for casual seating in an entryway, eat-in kitchen, or dining room Wood construction with a dark-brown finish; tapered legs offer reliable stability Cushioned seat upholstered in vinyl faux leather; beautiful stitch work and button tufting Simple assembly required (instructions, hardware, and tools included) Measures 49.5 by 15.8 by 19.3 inches (LxWxH)
